title: Who Visits the Flowers?

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: The bees don't make honey alone. Many little creatures visit our flowers, and some live in the pond instead.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Will you sort them? Flower visitors in the meadow, and pond creatures in the pond.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Put the creatures that visit flowers in the meadow, and the pond creatures in the pond.
steps.hint: Bees and butterflies visit flowers. Tadpoles and snails live in the water.

feedback.mismatch: Hmm, where does that one live? In the flowers, or in the water?
feedback.all_good: Everyone in the right place! The garden is full of life.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Every one of them has a part to play. The bees bring honey, the ladybirds eat the greenfly, and the tadpoles become frogs that eat the slugs!

journal_line: I sorted the creatures of the monastery garden with Brother Elias.
